items.title: Keysight (KEYS): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Keysight has followed the market’s trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 9.6% to $313.37 per share while the index has gained 13.7%.

items.title: Keysight's 56% Order Jump Puts AI Demand and Q4 Guidance in Focus
items.summary: KEYS Q3 orders surged 56% as AI infrastructure and connectivity demand grew, but supply constraints could limit near-term revenue conversion.

items.title: Should Investors Buy KEYS as Growth Surges but Valuation Looks Mixed?
items.summary: KEYS enters fiscal 2026's final stretch with faster AI-led growth and rising estimates, while valuation remains above broader market benchmarks.

items.title: Keysight Falls 11.1% in 3 Months While AI Demand Keeps Accelerating
items.summary: KEYS shares fell 11.1% in three months despite surging orders and earnings, as AI demand meets supply, policy and valuation risks.

items.title: Is Keysight Technologies Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
items.summary: Keysight Technologies has notably outperformed the S&P 500 over the past year, and analysts are highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Teradyne Looks Expensive Until You Price The AI Chips It Has Not Tested Yet
items.summary: Teradyne (TER) makes the equipment that tests semiconductors, and AI data centers have remade a business that last peaked on smartphones in 2021. The stock has returned about 185% over the past year. Even after falling about 32% from its 52-week high, it trades at about 41.8 times trailing adjusted earnings, the least useful number on the screen.

items.title: Can Verizon's 6G Acceleration Initiatives and AI Trials Drive Growth?
items.summary: VZ is advancing 6G with AI-native networks, real-world sensing trials and smart technologies, targeting the 2028 Olympics as a key test.

items.title: What Kind Of Swing Are You Signing Up For With Synopsys Stock?
items.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) trades near $400, and the options market has already drawn the boundaries it expects the stock to hold over roughly the next twelve months: about $251 at the floor and about $630 at the ceiling. That is a very wide year to be holding a single name. What matters is that for this stock, a range that wide is ordinary.
